exposure: Parent-reported total infections (from birth to 12 months)
outcome: Plasma metabolomic profiles (228 metabolites) at 6 and 12 months
Plasma lipidomic profiles (776 lipids) at 6 and 12 months
cohort: The study included 555 infants from a pre-birth longitudinal cohort.
finding: Infants with a greater infection burden in the first year of life had proinflammatory and proatherogenic plasma metabolomic and lipidomic profiles at 12 months of age, indicative of heightened cardiometabolic risk in adulthood.
